title: 9. Destinations Setup
description: Configuration and automatic discovery of SAP BTP HTTP and AI Core destinations with fallback cascading.
content:
What are Destinations?

In SAP BTP, destinations are configuration objects that define how applications connect to external systems or services. They centralize connection details (URL, authentication, proxy) so applications don't hardcode them.

BTP Cockpit Auto-Discovery Engine for AI Models

The application uses @sap-cloud-sdk/connectivity in srv/ai-destination.js to dynamically discover and auto-select bound Destinations from SAP BTP Cockpit without hardcoded API keys or secret URLs.

The 4 BTP Cockpit Model Destinations & Priority Order

Priority RankBTP Cockpit Destination NameTarget Model IDRole in Failover Cascade
Priority 1 (Primary)<code>google-diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it</code><code>google/diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it</code>Primary Model (First Choice)
Priority 2 (P2)<code>google-gemma-4-31b-it</code><code>google/gemma-4-31b-it</code>Secondary Model (P2)
Priority 3<code>z-ai-glm-5-2</code><code>z-ai/glm-5.2</code>Tertiary Model
Priority 4 (Fallback)<code>mistralai-mistral-nemotron</code><code>mistralai/mistral-nemotron</code>Designated Fallback Model

Destination Export Configurations

Export configuration files are stored under destination/:

Dynamic Auto-Selection Code Implementation

// srv/ai-destination.js
const { getDestination } = require('@sap-cloud-sdk/connectivity')

const CANDIDATE_DESTINATIONS = [
  process.env.AI_DESTINATION,
  'google-diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it',
  'google-gemma-4-31b-it',
  'z-ai-glm-5-2',
  'z-ai-glm-5.2',
  'mistralai-mistral-nemotron'
].filter(Boolean)

async function getAIDestination() {
  if (cachedDestination) return cachedDestination

  for (const name of CANDIDATE_DESTINATIONS) {
    try {
      const dest = await getDestination({ destinationName: name })
      if (dest?.url) {
        cachedDestination = {
          baseUrl: dest.url,
          apiKey: dest.authHeaders?.apikey || dest.originalProperties?.APIKey || '',
          model: dest.originalProperties?.Model || '',
          destinationName: name
        }
        return cachedDestination
      }
    } catch {
      // Candidate not bound in BTP Cockpit, check next
    }
  }
}
